articles.summary: ZEELAND, Mich. and STEINHAGEN, Germany, June 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Gentex Corporation and Hörmann today announced a strategic agreement to integrate Hörmann’s connected garage door opener technology into HomeLink, the automotive industry’s leading car-to-home automation system.
articles.title: Gentex and Hörmann Partner to Bring Cloud-Based Garage Door Control to HomeLink® in Europe
